title: Iterative Deepening Sampling as Efficient Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Weizhe Chen、Sven Koenig、Bistra Dilkina（机构：南加州大学、加州大学欧文分校）
paper_type_zh: 无需训练的迭代测试时采样研究
best_for_zh: 探索自我纠错如何分配推理时计算的读者。
one_line: Iterative Deepening Sampling uses progressively deeper self-correction samples to improve fixed-model reasoning at test time.
迭代加深采样以逐步加深的自我纠错样本改善固定模型的测试时推理。
why: It studies how to obtain more useful reasoning samples from a fixed model instead of merely increasing independent rollouts.
inclusion_reason: It allocates sampling depth at inference time to trigger model self-correction without changing model parameters.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fixed-model test-time scaling often adds independent samples, but independent attempts may repeat the same error and fail to exploit a model's ability to reconsider a partial solution. Training a separate critic or retraining the model can be costly, while a long single chain may not reliably self-correct.

The paper asks how a fixed reasoning model can spend more inference samples to trigger useful self-correction. It seeks a sampling schedule that progressively deepens reflection, rather than treating every rollout as an unrelated answer or relying on parameter updates.

固定模型的测试时扩展常增加独立样本，但独立尝试可能重复同一种错误，无法利用模型重新考虑部分解答的能力。训练单独的评判器或重新训练模型可能代价高昂，而单条很长的思维链也未必能可靠地自我纠错。

论文研究固定推理模型如何把更多推理样本用于触发有用的自我纠错。它寻找逐步加深反思的采样安排，而不是把每个采样轨迹看成互不相关的回答，或依赖参数更新。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Iterative Deepening Sampling treats self-correction as a resource that can be invoked at increasing levels of reasoning depth. Later samples are conditioned to revisit and improve earlier work, so the computation budget does not only buy more candidates; it buys opportunities for an existing line of reasoning to expose and repair its own mistakes.

The intended advantage is a better quality distribution of samples from the same model. The paper frames this as training-free inference-time scaling: the allocation policy changes how the model is sampled, while the model weights remain fixed.

迭代加深采样将自我纠错视为一种能够在不断提高的推理深度上调用的资源。后续样本被条件化为回看并改进早先工作，因此计算预算购买的不只是更多候选，还包括让同一条推理暴露并修复自身错误的机会。

预期优势是从同一模型获得质量分布更好的样本。论文将其表述为无需训练的测试时扩展：分配策略改变模型被如何采样，而模型权重保持固定。

title: Method
方法
html:
The framework samples a response and then constructs progressively deeper self-reflection attempts from prior reasoning. These attempts are organized as iterative deepening rather than flat repeated sampling, with the purpose of systematically activating correction behavior on difficult problems.

The method is evaluated as an inference procedure, not a new fine-tuning objective. Its records include the initial trace, reflection context, revised trace, depth level, sample budget, and final answer; these permit analysis of whether extra computation produced a distinct correction rather than another correlated completion.

该框架先采样一个响应，再从先前推理构造逐步更深的自我反思尝试。这些尝试按迭代加深组织，而不是平坦地重复采样，目的在于在困难问题上系统触发纠错行为。

该方法被作为推理过程评估，而不是新的微调目标。其记录包括初始轨迹、反思上下文、修订轨迹、深度层级、样本预算和最终答案；这些记录可以分析额外计算是否产生了不同的纠错，而不是另一条相关完成。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports experiments on Math500 and AIME, comparing the success of its deeper self-correction samples under varied settings. Its stated evidence is that iterative deepening can produce a higher success rate on difficult reasoning problems than the sampled baselines it considers.

The result should be read as evidence about the reported fixed models, prompts, and budgets, not as a guarantee that self-reflection is always beneficial. The paper provides ablations, but it is a preprint and no official code or data release was identified; reproductions should document sampling depth, token cost, and the fraction of revisions that actually correct an earlier answer.

论文报告在 Math500 和 AIME 上的实验，比较其更深自我纠错样本在不同设定下的成功情况。它给出的证据是：与所考虑的采样基线相比，迭代加深能够在困难推理问题上产生更高的成功率。

该结果应被理解为关于所报告固定模型、提示和预算的证据，而不是自我反思总是有益的保证。论文提供消融，但它仍是预印本，且未找到官方代码或数据发布；复现应记录采样深度、令牌成本以及修订真正纠正先前答案的比例。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper does not equate scaling with either longer one-shot thinking or a larger pool of independent completions. Its distinctive decision is to use successive sampling depths to expose a model to its own previous reasoning, making self-correction part of the sampling schedule.

This makes the training consumer explicit: a fixed model consumes prior traces as context at inference time, and the next rollout is chosen to deepen reflection. The contribution is therefore a test-time allocation policy for correction opportunities, rather than a dataset construction recipe or a new reward-model training method.

论文并不把扩展等同于更长的一次性思考或更大的独立完成池。其独特决定是使用连续的采样深度让模型接触自身先前推理，使自我纠错成为采样安排的一部分。

这使训练消费者变得明确：固定模型在推理时把先前轨迹作为上下文使用，下一次采样被选择为加深反思。因此，贡献是一项为纠错机会分配测试时计算的策略，而不是数据构造配方或新的奖励模型训练方法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Iterative reflection can reinforce a wrong premise, repeat the same reasoning pattern, or spend budget producing verbose but uninformative revisions. Its benefit depends on prompt design and the model's latent correction ability, and additional depth can increase sequential latency. Because the paper has no identified official artifact release, implementation details require particular care before deployment.
迭代反思可能强化错误前提、重复同一种推理模式，或花费预算生成冗长却没有信息量的修订。其收益取决于提示设计和模型潜在的纠错能力，增加深度也可能提高顺序延迟。由于未识别到论文的官方工件发布，部署前尤其需要谨慎核对实现细节。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a fixed reasoning model can accept earlier attempts in context and the service can tolerate some sequential refinement. Log each depth, revision prompt, answer change, correctness transition, tokens, and latency. Compare against equal-budget independent sampling and a single longer trace, because those controls reveal whether improvement comes from correction rather than merely from more generated text.
当固定推理模型能够在上下文中接受先前尝试，而且服务能够容忍一定顺序细化时，可以使用这项工作。应记录每个深度、修订提示、答案变化、正确性转变、令牌和延迟。应与相同预算的独立采样和单条更长轨迹比较，因为这些对照能揭示改进是否来自纠错，而不只是生成了更多文本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Audit the exact information passed from one depth to the next and inspect whether revised answers are independently checked. The central question is not whether later traces are longer, but whether they repair an identifiable earlier error. Separate gains on difficult items from average gains, since iterative deepening is intended to allocate extra work where an initial attempt is insufficient.
应审计每个深度传递给下一个深度的确切信息，并检查修订答案是否被独立验证。核心问题不是后续轨迹是否更长，而是它们是否修复了可识别的先前错误。应把困难样例上的增益与平均增益分开，因为迭代加深的目的正是在初次尝试不足之处投入额外工作。
